descriptions.FirstRun: A Python CLI that statically checks software repositories for first-run and onboarding issues — without executing repository code.
descriptions.Phonepad: Turns an Android phone into an Xbox 360-compatible controller for Windows over Wi-Fi, hotspot, or USB tethering using ViGEmBus.
descriptions.Intelligent-Candidate-Discovery: Hybrid semantic retrieval and candidate ranking system built with FAISS vector indexing, SentenceTransformers, and behavioral decay modeling.
